title: Commission-Free Ordering & Review Automation for Restaurants

blocks.heading: Ditch 30% Delivery *Commissions*
blocks.lead: Your own commission-free online ordering system, an automated review engine, and reservation automation. Your orders, your data, your rules.

items.title: The apps take up to 30% of every order.
items.body: Your customers. Your kitchen. Their margin — on every single ticket.

items.title: My best customers live on their app, not mine.
items.body: You don't get the customer data. You can't market to them. The app owns the relationship.

items.title: Five-star guests never leave reviews.
items.body: The quiet, happy tables say nothing. One bad night writes a paragraph.

items.title: Friday night is chaos.
items.body: Phone reservations, walk-ins, no-shows, and double-bookings all fighting for the same tables.

header.title: Your orders, *your data, your rules*
header.subtitle: One system that pays for itself — no app-store commissions, no per-order fees to a middleman.

items.title: Commission-Free Ordering
items.body: Your own online ordering on your website — branded, mobile-first, paid straight to your account. You keep every dollar.

items.title: Automated Review Engine
items.body: Happy diners get a perfectly timed text asking for a Google review. More 5-star reviews, more foot traffic, zero manual work.

items.title: Reservations on Autopilot
items.body: Online reservations with confirmation and reminder texts. Fewer no-shows, fuller tables, and automatic win-back offers for lapsed regulars.

blocks.math: $20,000/month in app orders × 28% commission × 50% shifted to your own ordering = *~$2,800/month saved*
blocks.assumptions: Assumptions: $20,000 in monthly third-party delivery orders; 28% average commission; half of that volume moves to your own commission-free ordering. Review and reservation revenue lift is extra on top. Your numbers will differ — the free audit maps your actual order mix.
blocks.disclaimer: Illustrative estimate for example purposes only. Actual results vary by concept, volume, and delivery mix.

items.title: USA-Based Team
items.body: Real humans, real support, your timezone.

items.title: Live in Weeks
items.body: Most systems up and running in 2–4 weeks.

items.title: Works With Your POS
items.body: Connects to your existing point-of-sale and payment setup.

items.title: No Long-Term Contracts
items.body: Month-to-month, cancel with 14 days' notice. If it doesn't pay for itself, walk away.

header.title: See exactly where *margin is leaking*
header.subtitle: A 30-minute working session — not a sales pitch. You leave with a fixed-quote plan whether or not you hire us.

items.title: Commission Leak Map
items.body: We map your order mix, review profile, and reservation chaos — and put a dollar figure on what the apps and no-shows are costing you.

items.title: Fixed-Quote Plan
items.body: You get an exact scope, timeline, and price for the ordering, review, and reservation system that fits your operation. No hourly billing.

items.title: Zero Commitment
items.body: Keep the plan and implement it yourself, or hand it to us. The audit is free either way.

items.a: It depends on scope — a single-location ordering site versus full ordering, reviews, and reservations. The free audit gives you a fixed quote before you spend anything.

items.q: Do I need a new POS?
items.a: No. We connect to the POS and payment setup you already have. If you don't have online ordering today, we'll build it on top of what you run now.

items.q: How fast can this be live?
items.a: Most systems are up and running in 2–4 weeks, including testing with your real menu and order flow.
You never touch code. Once it's live, ordering, review requests, and reservation reminders run themselves — you just watch the orders come in.

blocks.heading: Your customers. *Your margin.*
blocks.body: Get your free audit and see what your orders are really costing you — and what keeping them would look like.
